traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and named requirements for story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS are implemented and verified: - A dedicated ESLint rule (require-branch-annotation) detects missing @story/@req on all configured branch types using a clear, conventional ESLint RuleModule structure. - Comment association and annotation parsing are implemented via branch-annotation-helpers, including special handling for SwitchCase and support for both line and block comments. - Nested branches and a wide range of branch constructs (if/else, loops, switch, try/catch, do/while, for-of, for-in) are covered by comprehensive RuleTester suites. - Configuration is validated with clear error messages for invalid branchTypes, and the rule supports configurable scope over which branch types are enforced. - Performance is explicitly tested with large, deeply nested branch structures under a strict time budget, and helper implementations are careful to avoid unbounded scanning. - The rule is documented in docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md with examples, configuration guidance, and invalid configuration behavior, and it is integrated into the plugin’s recommended/strict configs.
Given the concrete implementation, tests, documentation, and successful Jest run, this story is fully implemented.
